__1 One possessed of sap or strength.

[ईष्-क] 
__1 The month Āśvina; cf. इष्. 
__2 A servant of Śiva.
Den. A. To move, excite; इयानास इषणयन्त धीभिः [[

f. 
__1 Sending, despatching. 
__2 Wish, desire, impulse.
Den. P. To excite, drive, urge on; ऋतस्य बुध्न उषसामिषण्यन् [[

Den. P. 
__1 To be juicy. 
__2 To swell, increase. 
__3 To be fresh or active. 
__4 To animate, strengthen.

a. 
__1 (The object) of aim. 
__2 Skilled in archery.

a. [ईश्-क] 
__1 Owning, possessing, sharing, master or lord of; see below. 
__2 One who is completely master of anything. 
__3 Capable of (with gen.) 
__4 Powerful, supreme. 
-शः 
__1 A lord, master; with gen. or in comp.; कथंचिदीशा मनसां बभूबुः [[

]] with great difficulty controlled (were masters of) their minds; so वागीश, सुरेश &c. 
__2 A husband. 
__3 A Rudra. 
__4 The number 11 (derived from the eleven Rudras). 
__5 N. of Śiva (as regent of the north-east quarter. 
__6 The Supreme god (परमेश्वर); व्यक्ताव्यक्तं भरते विश्वमीशमीड्यम् [[Śvet.

.]] 
__2 N. of Durgā. 
__3 A woman having supremacy; a rich lady. 
-Comp. 
-कान्तः A class of the eleven-storeyed buildings. ([[

-11]]). 
-कोणः the north-east quarter. 
-गीता f. N. of a section of the Kūrma Purāṇa. 
-दण्डः Axle-pole of a car. 
-पुरी, -नगरी N. of Benares. 
-बलम् the missile पाशुपत. 
-सखः an epithet of Kubera.

[ईष्-क] 
__1 The pole or shafts of a carriage or a plough. ईषा चकादिसंनिधाने चेदक्षमानयेत्युच्यते तदा यानाक्षमधिकृत्य ब्रूते

.]] ‘ईषा लाङ्गलदण्डः स्यात्’ इत्यमरः 
__2 A part of a chariot. 
-षे (du.) The double or fork-shaped pole. 
-Comp. 
-दण्डः the handle of a plough; ईषादण्डौ मृत्युशय्यातलस्य [[Śi. 18. 43.]] 
-दन्त a. with projecting teeth. 
(-न्तः) 
__1 an elephant with a large tusk or tooth. 
__2 the handle of a plough; ईषादन्तः कुञ्जरं शात्रवीयम् [[Śi. 18. 38.]] 
__3 the tusk of an elephant.
N. of the ईशावास्योपनिषद्, also called ईशोपनिषद्; the only instance of an upaniṣad included in a Saṃhitā ([[

[ईश्-ल्युट्] 
__1 Commanding, reigning &c. 
__2 Greatness, glory; एतदीशनमीशस्य प्रकृतिस्थोऽपि तद्गुणैः [[

a. [ईश् ताच्छील्ये चानश्] 
__1 Owning, possessing, master or lord. 
__2 Reigning, ruling. 
__3 Wealthy, rich. 
-नः 
__1 A ruler, master, lord; ईशानो भूतभव्यस्य [[Kaṭh. 4. 12.]] 
__2 N. of Śiva; ईशानसंदर्शनलालसानाम् [[

.]] 
__3 The Ārdrā Nakṣtra. 
__4 One of the Rudras. 
__5 The number 'eleven'. 
__6 The sun as a form of Śiva. पर्जन्यो यमो मृत्युरीशानः [[Bṛ.

.]] 
__7 A Sādhya. 
__8 N. of Viṣṇu. 
-नी N. of Durgā. 
-नी, -नः The silk-cotton tree (शाल्मली; Mar. सांवरी). 
-नम् Light, splendour. 
-Comp. 
-आदिपञ्चमूर्तिः f. one of the five forms of Śiva. 
-कल्पः N. of a Kalpa. 
-कृत् a. 
__1 making one a master or able. 
__2 acting like a competent person.

ईषण,
ईषणिन् a. Hastening. 
-णा Haste, speed.
ind. [ईष्-अति] 1 Slightly, to some extent, a little; ईषत् चुम्बितानि [[Ś. 1. 4]]; ईषच्च कुरुते सेवाम् [[
.]] Easily done, with very little exertion; ईषत्कार्यमिदं कार्यं कृतमासीन्न संशयः [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-उष्ण a. tepid, [Page0394-2] slightly warm. 
-ऊन a. not quite complete, a little less than; ईषदूनार्धे कल्पप्. 
-कर a. 
__1 doing little. 
__2 easy to be accomplished; [[

.]] 
(-रम्) very little. 
-कार्य a. very easy, connected with slight effort; ईषत्कार्यो वधस्तस्य [[

.]] 
-गुण a. of little merit. 
-जलम् shallow water, a little water. 
-दर्शनम् a glance, sight, view, glimpse. 
-दीर्घः An almond. 
-नाद a. slightly sounding (a term applied to unaspirated soft consonants). 
-निमय a. exchanged for a little. 
-पाण्डु a. a little white or pale, whitish. 
(-ण्डुः) a pale or light-brown colour. 
-पान a. that of which a little is drunk. ईषत्पानः सोमो भवता [[Sk.]] आनोयुच् [[

.]] (नम्) a small draught. 
-पुरुषः a mean or contemptible person. 
-बीजा Quince-seed, Dyrus Cydonia (Mar. बेदाणा). 
-रक्त a. pale red. 
(-क्तः) 
__1 pale-red colour. 
__2 undistinguishable colour. 
-लभ, -प्रलाभ a. to be got for little. 
-विवृत a. slightly open. 
-वीर्यः Almond tree. 
-श्वास a. slightly resounding. 
-स्पृष्ट a. slightly touched (applied to the semivowels) ईषत्स्पृष्टमन्तस्थानम् [[Sk.]] 
-हासः slight laughter, a smile.
N. of the fourth yoga in Astrology.
